explication: Hashcat is a password-recovery platform. A typical run accepts a user’s attack configuration and hash inputs, generates candidate passwords, evaluates them against selected hash modes on CPU/GPU or optional FPGA hardware, and reports recovered hashes. The graph also preserves documented attack-generation, recipe, bridge, Brain, and session capabilities. Source excerpts are partial, so the internal execution links are limited to relationships the README documents; unsampled implementation details are not inferred.
